what_it_measured.text: To validate the predictions, the in vitro antihypertensive potential of the five peptides with the highest potential was first measured.
This study aims to draw attention through a critical study on how bioinformatics analysis is employed in the identification of bioactive peptides in the laboratory.

dose.text: We performed the digestions considering reaching a concentration of 50 µg mL−1 in the simulation of the intestinal compartment.

endpoint.text: To validate the predictions, the in vitro antihypertensive potential of the five peptides with the highest potential was first measured.
Antihypertensive Activity To validate the in silico predictions, we measured the ability of the five peptides to inhibit ACE in vitro (iACE).
The iACE of each sample (raw peptide and digested) was evaluated in duplicate and expressed as the concentration capable of inhibiting 50% of the enzymatic activity (IC50 ).

reported_results.text: Now, returning to the results obtained by BIOPEP, when the IC50 is removed from the equation of B (Equation (1)) and converted from µM to µg mL−1 , the following values were obtained: QSLVYPFTGPIPNSL, 4.1 µg mL−1 ; SWMHQPP, 72.6 µg mL−1 ; YPYQGPIVL, 86.2 µg mL−1 ; HQPPQPL, 129.3 µg mL−1 ; MHQPPQPL, 150.1 µg mL−1 .

Subsequently, a pepsin solution, 25 mg/mL, was added with a ratio of 0.05 mL/mL of a sample at pH 2.0 (simulated gastric solution, stomach) following incubation for 2 h, 37 ◦ C at 130 rpm orbital agitation for the gastric phase.
results were expressed in µmol TE by mg of peptide (µmol TE mg−1 ), after the calculation of Trolox concentration through regression curve equation. 4.2.4.
Separation of means was conducted by using the least significant difference at the 5% level of probability.
